description: A preview of the output. In a job without an API key it is free and covers an unpaid file's first 5 pages with bookings or first 125 bookings (all bookings of a smaller file; PDF bookings without a page are left out). Its file name marks it as not for bookkeeping; it serves only to check the result. With an API key it runs the export: the first export of a final file uses up the plan's units. Returns a download link valid for 1 hour, at most until the job ends.

account_iban.description: MT940 only: IBAN of the statement's account.

closing_balance.description: MT940 only: balance after the last booking; with opening_balance KP checks a statement without balances for completeness.

datev.description: DATEV header data from the user's tax office. Required for DATEV files of anonymous jobs: berater_nummer (4-7 digits) and mandanten_nummer (1-5 digits). Optional fiscal_year_start (YYYY-MM-DD, first day of a month; default 1 January of the first booking's year).

file_id.description: A file_id from get_job_status; optional when the job has one file.

format.description: Output format; default: the job's target_format.

opening_balance.description: MT940 only: balance before the first booking, e.g. 1234.56; omit when the statement shows it.

name: get_preview
title: Preview file
